branches.title: Explanation / Объяснение
branches.summary: Choose a question, visible operations and a coherent ending.

branches.title: Drawing and layout / Рисунок и размещение
branches.summary: Create scenes, measured text, exact connectors and source-image views.

branches.title: Motion and viewpoint / Движение и ракурс
branches.summary: Preserve actors through motion and distinguish camera changes from scientific change.

branches.title: Distributions and evidence / Распределения и выводы
branches.summary: Compare distributions, quantify variation and explain statistical decisions.

branches.title: Biological structures and records / Биологические структуры и записи
branches.summary: Explain molecular structures, gene expression, observed counts, aggregation, normalization and alleles.

branches.title: 3D scenes and surfaces / 3D-сцены и поверхности
branches.summary: Compose procedural biological surfaces, molecules, capture chemistry and barcode records; choose source coordinates when atomic evidence is required.

branches.title: Chemistry and physical models / Химия и физические модели
branches.summary: Connect atoms, bonds and chemical reactions to biological processes through explicit schematic and numerical models.

branches.title: Geometry and data organization / Геометрия и организация данных
branches.summary: Project vectors, transform coordinates, reorder matrices and assign observation roles.

branches.title: Controls and questions / Управление и вопросы
branches.summary: Add manual inputs, accessible SVG regions, questions and interaction checks.

branches.title: Reading experience / Чтение и оформление
branches.summary: Adapt language, appearance, shell and mobile gestures without losing state.

branches.title: Verification and delivery / Проверка и экспорт
branches.summary: Preserve provenance, inspect rendered lessons, build standalone HTML and upgrade carefully.

concepts.title: Persistent scene / Постоянная сцена
concepts.summary: Create scene objects once and update them through authored states with F.stage and F.step.
concepts.caveat: Object identity must match scientific identity; provide a note for every state and clean up scene resources.

concepts.title: Persistent motion / Движение одних объектов
concepts.summary: Use F.motionTrack for keyed poses and F.shared for semantically identical actors across adjacent scenes.

guides.section: Continue an object across adjacent scenes

concepts.caveat: Read each selected motion contract and register cleanup; intermediate geometry is an explanation, not evidence of a measured trajectory.

concepts.title: Camera and depth disclosure / Ракурс и третья координата
concepts.summary: Project fixed world coordinates with K.project3D and K.spatialScene while explaining what the camera reveals.
concepts.caveat: A camera does not recover missing depth, fit UMAP or turn a 2D image into measured 3D coordinates.

concepts.title: Measured text layout / Измеряемое размещение текста
concepts.summary: Reserve intended boxes with L.textBox, L.rows, L.columns and L.contract, then measure the rendered text.

guides.section: Contracts for existing labels and HTML

concepts.caveat: Measure after font loading in the promised locales and appearance modes; unmeasured text is not passing and text boxes do not prove stroke clearance.

concepts.title: Label and stroke clearance / Зазоры подписей и линий
concepts.summary: Reserve space around complete formulas, axes, vectors and closed contours throughout motion.

guides.section: Проверяйте контакт, а не только прямоугольники

concepts.caveat: These are composition and review techniques, not an automatic collision-avoidance API; inspect actual shapes and intermediate frames.

concepts.title: Exact anchors and guides / Точные крепления и направляющие
concepts.summary: Attach flat-ended guides to current geometry using K.boxAnchor and K.guideSpan.

guides.section: Recompute connections from the current pose

concepts.caveat: Calculate the object and its connector endpoints from the same current pose; exact attachments do not establish collision-free routing.

concepts.title: Indexed sequence / Последовательность с индексами
concepts.summary: Keep symbols, indices and supplied relations visible while changing their arrangement with K.sequenceTrack.
concepts.caveat: The author supplies coordinates and relations; this helper predicts neither molecular structure nor valid base pairing.

concepts.title: Matrix and heatmap / Матрица и тепловая карта
concepts.summary: Reorder a displayed matrix with K.heatmap while preserving cell values and a fixed color scale.
concepts.caveat: Permuting rows and columns is not clustering; supplied orders must be bijections and the quantitative color range must remain explicit.

concepts.title: Observation partitions / Разделение наблюдений
concepts.summary: Assign persistent observation IDs to construction, reserve and evaluation roles with K.partitionActors.
concepts.caveat: Each ID must occur exactly once; moving records into groups does not train or validate a model.

concepts.title: Spread and mean precision / Разброс и точность среднего
concepts.summary: Show residuals, sample variance, SD and SEM with K.sampleSummary and K.sampleSpread.
concepts.caveat: SD and SEM answer different questions; the author must identify independent sampling units and must not treat a displayed interval as an automatic confidence interval.

concepts.title: Exact mean permutation / Точная перестановка групп
concepts.summary: Reassign persistent records and enumerate small unpaired mean-difference tests with K.exactMeanPermutation and K.permutationView.
concepts.caveat: The exact small-sample unpaired enumeration requires exchangeability; it is not a general paired, clustered or arbitrarily pooled-null testing engine.

concepts.title: Benjamini–Hochberg / Множественное тестирование
concepts.summary: Sort hypothesis IDs, locate the final passing rank and select its prefix with K.bhAdjust and K.bhView.
concepts.caveat: Explain the procedure's assumptions and family of tests; a BH-adjusted value is not a posterior probability that a hypothesis is true.

concepts.title: Resampling copies / Выборки с возвращением
concepts.summary: Trace source records into supplied resamples and their means with K.resampleMean.
concepts.caveat: Repeated IDs are copies, not new observations; the view neither generates confidence intervals nor establishes the resampling unit or dependence structure.

concepts.title: Matched predictions / Сопоставленные предсказания
concepts.summary: Compare observed and predicted scalar values for the same IDs using K.predictionComparison and synchronized Pearson/L2 readouts.
concepts.caveat: L2 is not RMSE; Pearson for a constant series is undefined, and comparison does not fit a predictive model.

concepts.title: Classification threshold / Порог классификации
concepts.summary: Connect score thresholds to selected records, integer counts, precision/recall and average precision.
concepts.caveat: Keep equal scores grouped under score ≥ threshold; the area is discrete average precision, with recall/AP undefined when there are no positive cases.

concepts.title: Observations and quantiles / Наблюдения и квантили
concepts.summary: Represent observations as an empirical inverse CDF with K.empiricalDistribution and distinguish that model from its query grid.

guides.section: Observations become an empirical inverse CDF

concepts.caveat: Increasing the probability-grid size adds evaluation positions, not observations; quantile boundary rules and bin boundaries must remain explicit.

concepts.title: One-dimensional transport / Одномерное расстояние и центр
concepts.summary: Compute empirical W2 with K.wasserstein1D and average aligned quantile-grid curves with K.quantileBarycenter.

guides.section: Average quantile curves on a shared grid

concepts.caveat: Exact empirical integration uses floating-point arithmetic; grid-curve averaging does not reconstruct an exact unequal-size empirical barycenter or establish statistical significance.

concepts.title: Cells to sample evidence / Клетки и образцы
concepts.summary: Sum raw cell contributions by sample and stratum with K.aggregateCounts and K.countAggregation.

guides.section: Raw counts by sample and stratum

concepts.caveat: Grouping and summing counts does not perform differential expression or make cells independent biological replicates.

concepts.title: Count normalization / Нормализация счётчиков
concepts.summary: Disclose each row's common-total scaling factor and a separate log1p transform with K.normalizeCountRows and K.countNormalization.

guides.section: A common total, then natural log1p

concepts.caveat: Scaled values are derived values, not new molecules; retain raw counts and label raw, normalized and log scales separately.

concepts.title: Genotypes to alleles / Генотипы и аллели
concepts.summary: Count two allele copies per diploid genotype and show separate HWE expectations with K.alleleSummary and K.alleleFrequency.

guides.section: Diploid allele frequencies and separate HWE expectations

concepts.caveat: HWE probabilities are model expectations, not observed genotypes; illustrative individual indices are reconstructed from supplied genotype tallies.

concepts.title: Circle to wave / Окружность и волна
concepts.summary: Relate a rotating radius to signed sine/cosine components using K.circleComponents and K.unitCircleView.
concepts.caveat: Keep radians and sign visible; the supplied view's trace has a documented finite angular range.

concepts.title: Projection and PCA / Проекция и PCA
concepts.summary: Project explicit 2D points, retain discarded residuals and explain exact 2D PCA with K.projectOnto2D, K.pca2D and K.projectionView.
concepts.caveat: State centering and coordinate meaning; these explicit 2D helpers neither fit UMAP nor infer hidden dimensions.

concepts.title: Linear map and area / Линейное преобразование и площадь
concepts.summary: Transform basis directions and a unit square while computing determinant and area with K.linearMap2D and K.linearMapView.
concepts.caveat: Signed determinant and ordinary area differ; a linear map changes coordinates whereas a camera changes their view.

concepts.title: Questions, hints and guide / Вопросы, подсказки и конспект
concepts.summary: Use T.ponder for a prediction before the answer and scene.qa for current-scene questions and the searchable lesson guide.
concepts.caveat: Write topic-specific hints, answers and sources in the promised locales; optional reading cannot replace labels essential to the drawing.

concepts.title: Manual inputs / Ручное управление
concepts.summary: Connect T.control and T.buttons to one current state and an interruptible F.driver paint function.
concepts.caveat: Register driver.dispose with ctx.onDispose and compute current values, marks and captions together; controls must retain keyboard and native reading behavior.

concepts.title: Whole SVG activation region / Полная SVG-область нажатия
concepts.summary: Add an accessible transparent rectangular target, translated label and independent focus indicator with T.svgButton.
concepts.caveat: Keep activation rectangles disjoint and focus/selection clear of numeric labels; verify actual blank-area clicks and keyboard focus, not only dispatched events.

concepts.title: Hit-region inspection / Проверка зон нажатия
concepts.summary: Inspect declared SVG hit rectangles for overlap and sampled native hit coverage without activating their callbacks.

guides.section: Opt in with a real hit rectangle

concepts.caveat: Sampled rectangles do not prove continuous coverage, correct callbacks or keyboard behavior; no declared regions means zero coverage, not a global pass.

concepts.title: Question to operation / От вопроса к действию
concepts.summary: Choose each scene's question, input objects, visible operation, result and preserved identity before composing the lesson.

guides.section: A scene should earn its motion

concepts.caveat: The examples are a menu, not a required outline; teaching values must not be relabeled as evidence from the user's material.

concepts.title: Recurring conceptual map / Повторяющаяся смысловая карта
concepts.summary: Reuse topic-specific motifs to connect local operations, formulas and a final answer to the opening question.

guides.section: Build the explanation around a question
Turn a result into an explanation

concepts.caveat: The map is an authored composition, not a universal API; keep known routes readable and replay limited to available paths without changing current parameters or selection.

concepts.title: Branched synthesis / Разветвлённая общая карта
concepts.summary: Compose two construction inputs and separate evaluation branches around one consistent model with the pipeline-synthesis recipe.
concepts.caveat: The exported toy is not a general scientific API; unrelated examples must not imply one numerical pipeline, and a reference unavailable during construction belongs only to evaluation.

concepts.title: Live appearance / Переключаемое оформление
concepts.summary: Use semantic C roles and supplied Source fonts so background, palette and text family can change without rebuilding scenes.
concepts.caveat: Do not parse live C values as hex or append alpha suffixes; preserve state, quantitative scales and complete font notices across appearance changes.

concepts.title: RU/EN authoring / Русский и английский
concepts.summary: Author scene, note and Q&A translations with D.i18n packs while preserving current input, progress and persistent source nodes.
concepts.caveat: Translate full source strings or anchored sentences; language changes must not rebuild scenes, alter numbers or overwrite source nodes with already translated text.

concepts.title: Native touch and reading / Жесты и чтение на телефоне
concepts.summary: Keep one-finger lesson navigation scoped to the drawing while preserving native pinch, zoomed panning and reading-pane gestures.

guides.section: Native pinch and required shell settings

concepts.caveat: Do not disable browser zoom or apply blanket touch-action:none; synthetic events do not establish native gesture arbitration on a physical device.

concepts.title: Source figure window / Область исходного рисунка
concepts.summary: Show a precise region of an original image with K.sourceWindow and retain full-source access through T.evidence.
concepts.caveat: Preserve image dimensions, source and permitted use; a crop or schematic reconstruction cannot manufacture raw measurements or missing dimensions.

concepts.title: Sources and ownership / Источники и права
concepts.summary: Retain scientific source records, distinguish invented fixtures from evidence and preserve factual ownership and complete font notices.
concepts.caveat: The kit's availability does not grant rights to unrelated article content, and toy values are not evidence for the user's topic.

concepts.title: Stable lesson shell / Постоянная оболочка
concepts.summary: Retain the five fixed controls and one tabbed reading panel without sizing the canvas from localized toolbar content.
concepts.caveat: For ordinary authoring change episodes and metadata first; keep shell.css last and preserve documented hooks and native reading controls.

concepts.title: Verify and export / Проверка и экспорт
concepts.summary: Check scientific values, intended bounds, intermediate motion and real interactions, then build and inspect the actual standalone HTML.
concepts.caveat: Build/bundle --check does not write updated HTML; DOM tests, finite coordinates and unmeasured regions cannot substitute for rendered inspection and truthful reporting of unavailable checks.

concepts.title: Upgrade an existing lesson / Обновление урока
concepts.summary: Select the relevant version migration while preserving authored episodes, translations, values and public integration contracts.

guides.section: С версии 0.11: общая карта и зоны нажатия
С версии 0.8: внутренние границы и преобразования

concepts.caveat: Updating the library alone does not update an existing lesson; load the migration section for its starting version and verify the resulting artifact.

concepts.title: Schematic molecular actors / Схематичные молекулярные акторы
concepts.summary: Build persistent nucleic acids, CRISPR proteins, chromatin and expression actors; control contextual and focused parts with stable line weights.
concepts.caveat: These are purpose-built schematic SVG actors with authored states and trajectories, not atom coordinates, a structure predictor, reaction kinetics or a molecular dynamics solver.

concepts.title: Molecular simulation / Молекулярное моделирование
concepts.summary: Recognize when folding physics, validated trajectories or a general molecular viewer requires tools and evidence outside this kit.
concepts.caveat: The kit provides no folding physics, validated molecular trajectories or general structure viewer. Curated source-backed RNA coordinate projections are available through molecular-coordinates; camera motion does not simulate folding.

concepts.title: Histone chemistry and initiation / Химия гистонов и инициация
concepts.summary: Explain H3K9 trimethylation, reader recognition, Mediator and a schematic Pol II initiation complex with preserved actors.
concepts.caveat: Schematic structure and graphical transitions; methylation fractions do not depict reaction intermediates, and PIC convergence does not assert an obligatory assembly order.

concepts.title: CRISPR families and RNA processing / Семейства CRISPR и обработка РНК
concepts.summary: Compose Cas12a, Cas13, pre-mRNA and spliceosome actors to distinguish DNA targeting, RNA targeting and a schematic splicing operation.
concepts.caveat: Authored schematic geometry, not a universal guide sequence, atomic structure, splice-site predictor or splicing kinetic model. Distinct CRISPR protein families require compatible guide architecture.

concepts.title: Enlarged molecular detail / Крупный план молекулы
concepts.summary: Add an accessible enlarged snapshot of an existing molecular actor or named part while retaining the underlying lesson state.
concepts.caveat: The detail view is a captured schematic frame, not new structural evidence or live molecular motion. Its opening and cleanup must be registered with the scene lifecycle.

concepts.title: Molecular visual check / Проверка молекулярных элементов
concepts.summary: Create a reusable seven-element visual test cycle with animated states, a captured enlarged view and optional browser QA.
concepts.caveat: This authored visual test cycle checks schematic states and interaction, not biophysics, molecular trajectories or reaction kinetics. Browser QA is opt-in with ?qa=1.

concepts.title: Chemical structures and reactions / Химические структуры и реакции
concepts.summary: Compose persistent chemical drawings with atoms, covalent bonds and reaction representations; keep schematic geometry separate from calculated structure.
concepts.caveat: Chemical drawings are authored schematics, not calculated quantum states, validated atomic coordinates or molecular-dynamics trajectories. Explicit model assumptions belong to each numerical calculation.

concepts.title: Physical chemistry models / Модели физической химии
concepts.summary: Calculate energy, reaction kinetics, acid-base balance, diffusion and related physical quantities with explicit inputs, units and assumptions.
concepts.caveat: Numerical models have explicit units and idealizations; equilibrium, rates, probabilities and individual trajectories are distinct quantities. These helpers do not simulate an atomistic cell.

concepts.title: Chemistry to biology lesson / Химия → биология
concepts.summary: Create the v0.17.0 bilingual chemistry-to-biology lesson: 16 continuous visual stories, 48–60 s playback, causal narration, retained actors, linked geometry and model values, with explicit chemical bookkeeping.
concepts.caveat: The lesson distinguishes authored chemical representations from computed model values. Browser QA is opt-in with ?qa=1; the animation is not a molecular-dynamics trajectory.

concepts.title: RNA folding lesson / Укладка РНК
concepts.summary: Reproduce a coherent RU/EN RNA lesson: 17 scenes and 63 states, connected atomic views, pairing and stacking, retained whole-molecule context, tertiary contacts, hydrated magnesium, folding during synthesis and prediction evidence.
concepts.caveat: Deposited coordinates and schematic examples are distinguished. Camera motion is not a folding trajectory; no predictor is run. Physical gestures require physical testing.

concepts.title: Connected atomic coordinate views / Связанные атомные модели
concepts.summary: Use MC.rnaFragment, MC.context and MC.project to preserve source atom identity, explicit fragment bonds, whole-molecule context and camera geometry while enlarging or rotating an RNA contact.
concepts.caveat: A source-backed SVG renderer for curated RNA fragments, not a general PDB/mmCIF parser, molecular dynamics engine, bond inference tool or folding predictor. Ring polygons are not molecular surfaces.

concepts.title: Molecular construction kit / Конструктор 3D-комплекса
concepts.summary: Assemble an editable protein–RNA overview and connected atomic close-up with a retained context locator. Two ready scene presets over reusable MV assembly, detail, fit and rig bricks; portable PDB preparation and verified 7BG9 example.
concepts.caveat: Camera-based source coordinates, explicit trace connectivity and selected RNA/DNA atoms; no molecular surfaces, automatic biological assembly, folding physics or measured trajectory. Bounded PDB importer rejects unsupported identities.

concepts.title: Reusable 3D biology components / Компоненты 3D-биологии
concepts.summary: Reuse V3 molecule meshes, a depth-tested cell surface, solid capture beads and primers, aqueous droplets, RNA/tag strands, three-code records, paired RNA/ADT libraries and enlarged data-field cards. Compose authored camera, binding, wash, lysis and hybridization states without replacing object identity.
concepts.caveat: Original procedural illustrative geometry, not atomic source coordinates, a protein-count measurement, molecular dynamics, hydrodynamics or kinetic simulation. Camera changes preserve object identity; barcode records are logical fields, not exact library sequence architecture.

concepts.title: Spatial biology template / Пространственная биология
concepts.summary: Build an editable three-scene RU/EN 3D lesson: antibody labelling, rotation and close-up, washing, one-cell/one-bead droplet, lysis and co-capture, then cell barcode, feature identity and UMI, followed by RNA and ADT library separation with the shared cell barcode preserved. Reuse R1/R2 readout close-ups, RNA gene mapping, ADT antibody-dictionary lookup and paired profiles, with camera motion completed before readout labels appear. Optional --template spatial-biology includes reusable V3 components and Bio3D recipes.

guides.section: Primary sources for the readout scenario

concepts.caveat: Editable teaching schematic for the original solid-bead Drop-seq CITE-seq workflow; geometry, colours, visible molecule counts and trajectories are illustrative. Co-capture precedes synthesis; the source RNA and antibody tag do not acquire a cell barcode at hybridization. Recipes are copied into other templates without being loaded.
